title: Archicad-class BIM authoring expansion
objective: Expand the verified CAD/BIM product into the next bounded Archicad-class architectural authoring layer: richer architectural building elements and deterministic relationships, classification/property semantics, and bounded renovation/design-option lifecycle state, while preserving the frozen ConstructionOS/CAD architecture.
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic representative workflows create and edit supported roof, stair and railing elements with canonical host/story relationships.
Existing space/zone semantics remain valid and participate in supported vertical and lifecycle relationships.
Classification and structured property edits persist through save/open/replay and map through Construction Graph using canonical identities.
Renovation state and bounded design-option membership are deterministic, persisted, and do not require destructive model duplication.
Web and Electron produce equivalent semantic streams and canonical serialized results for the pinned P011 fixture.
Real OCCT coverage exists for supported new geometry; reference/dummy adapters return typed deterministic declines for unsupported operations.
Existing CAD-PARITY-002..010, BIM, IFC, documentation, governance and real-engine regression suites remain green and previous fixtures remain byte-identical.
No protected architecture files are modified.
The exact implementation head is CI-verified and deployed/browser-verified on Vercel.
Governance evidence binds tests, CI, deployments, review state, exact revisions and timestamps.
non_goals: Full freeform roof/shell editing with arbitrary complex topology.
Full renovation/design-option history parity beyond the bounded canonical states.
risk_assumptions: CAD-PARITY-010 is VERIFIED on main at merge commit 3c476b51239d0e29b8174451fdc0ea365010978e.
COMPAT-BIM-003, RESEARCH-CAD-007 and COMPAT-CAD-003 are VERIFIED and provide the existing BIM/component/feasibility baseline.
P011 composes with, rather than replaces, the already-verified component/material subsystem.
Native geometry and IFC engines remain isolated behind the established adapter/worker boundary.
Unsupported architectural element operations must be explicit typed declines rather than fabricated geometry or silent approximation.
evidence_requirements: Deterministic unit and workflow suites for roofs, stairs, railings, host/story relationships, classification/properties and lifecycle semantics.
Web/Electron parity fixtures covering representative architectural element creation/editing and lifecycle state.
Real-OCCT coverage through the existing EngineAdapterBundle/worker boundary plus explicit reference-engine declines where unsupported.
Regression proof that CAD-PARITY-002..010 fixtures remain green and byte-identical.
Exact-head Vercel deployment and real-browser verification of the representative P011 workflows.
Governance evidence bound to exact implementation revisions and CI/deployment identities.

transitions.reason: Architect released CAD-PARITY-011 as the next roadmap work item after CAD-PARITY-010 verification. Scope was derived from the frozen Phase 5 BIM roadmap and the repository's already-verified BIM/component foundations, avoiding duplication of completed component/material work.

Dependency gates are verified on main. The work item is assigned to the logical implementation agent z-ai-implementation-agent; GitHub does not expose that logical agent as a repository user, so the assignment is recorded authoritatively in the governance ledger.
